description: On Tuesday, August 30th, Leon Stavrinakis received a perfect score on the annual South Carolina Chamber of Commerce scorecard as well as the endorsement from the Conservation Voters of South Carolina. Each legislative session, the Chamber tracks roll call votes on key business issues and tallies them to determine an overall score for each member of the General Assembly.
